subject: general
question:
Which of the following is/are the cause of the economic boom?

1. Lower costs of borrowing

2. Reduction in taxes by the government

3. Lowering asset prices

4. Increased interest rate on a loan

Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
solution:
The correct answer is __**1 and 2 only**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A boom is a period of rapid economic expansion resulting in higher GDP, lower unemployment,* *a higher inflation rate, and rising asset prices.
 
• It is the final phase of expansion, before heading for the peak.
 
• If the boom is fuelled by higher consumer spending and rising asset prices, then we are more likely to see demand outstripping supply resulting in higher inflation. Thereby the economy heats up, and the demand-supply lag is visible.

**Causes of an economic boom:**

 
• If monetary policy is eased and the economy is expanding at a pace that is near to the long-run trend rate (cut in interest rates). This will boost the economy's demand even more.
 
• The** decreased borrowing costs** will promote consumer and investment expenditure. ***Hence 1 is correct.***
 
• The overall demand will increase as a result. A mortgage and home purchase will also be more alluring with** lower interest rates**. *Hence 4 is incorrect.*
 
• Consumer spending and aggregate demand will increase **if the government lowers taxes at a time when the economy is almost at capacity** and is being supported by increasing borrowing. *Hence 2 is correct.*
 
• A **positive wealth effect is produced by rising asset prices**, including those of stocks and houses. This boosts confidence and makes it possible to remortgage in order to withdraw equity. A feedback loop between increased growth, rising prices, and high confidence also push asset prices upward. This passion for investing in assets that are appreciating might be separate from an underlying valuation. *Hence 3 is incorrect.*

Characteristics of an economic boom:

 
• Business production and economic output grows
 
• Consumer spending and aggregate demand goes up
 
• Household income increases
 
• Unemployment rate
 
• Tax revenue goes up
 
• High imports
 
• Prolonged high demand
